environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on EC2 behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TLS termination. Service runs in a private subnet with security group allowing inbound on port 3000 from the NLB target group. No application-layer filtering is configured. CloudWatch logs enabled for access monitoring. The NLB operates at Layer 4 and does not inspect HTTP payloads.

config.network: VPC private subnet, SG allows NLB health checks and forwarding
config.monitoring: CloudWatch Logs agent, no alerting on payload content
